subject: Kazakhstan
note: Hand-curated research for a Geographica episode about Kazakhstan. Claims are cited to pinned Wikipedia revisions (trusted_secondary).

claims.text: Kazakhstan is the world’s ninth-largest country by land area and the largest landlocked country.
As of 2026 there are 44 landlocked countries.
Kazakhstan has a population of 20.6 million and one of the lowest population densities in the world.
Hilly plateaus and plains account for nearly half its territory, with lowlands composing another third; its southern and eastern frontiers are mountainous.
